ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity (off-white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, with dark pixels localized primarily at the perimeter and specific focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity field across both lobes. Low-intensity geometric blobs are visible at: 1. A distinct circular focal spot on the right lobe (mid-lateral). 2. An irregular cluster of dark pixels at the base of the fluke near the peduncle. 3. Solid dark banding along the entire length of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated shallow U-shaped notch with an obtuse internal angle of approximately 115 degrees and a shallow depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration pattern; irregular peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in depth, continuous from the median notch to both tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave sweep from the median notch toward the lateral tips; leading edge (where visible above water) exhibits a convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel cluster at the central base/peduncle junction and a singular high-contrast circular spot on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark circular spot on the right lobe; irregular dark pigmentation clusters at the base; dark ragged texture at the terminal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe contains a singular, isolated dark circular pigmentation mark at approximately the horizontal midpoint.
